title: Italian Bao Sliders
description: A creative twist on traditional Italian subs, using flaky German bao as the foundation for a rich meat and cheese sandwich.

ingredients.name: Flaky German Bao
ingredients.notes: Split down the center to form a pocket

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Used for cooking the meat and buns

instructions: Preheat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil to the pan and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the ground beef to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Season the beef with salt and pepper to taste.
Split the flaky German bao in half and toast them in the pan for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Assemble the sliders by spooning the beef mixture onto the bottom half of each bao, followed by a slice of provolone cheese.
Top each slider with a sprinkle of chopped fresh basil and the top half of the bao.
Serve the Italian bao sliders immediately and enjoy!
